entry.title: Z950 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Keebz Z950 v1.0.1 Z950 is an insert effect for Akai MPC standalone hardware. It is a live S-series style time stretch and pitch shift (CYCLIC and INTELL modes, after the Akai S1000), an S900/S950 style low-pass filter, 8/12/16/24-bit and sample-rate reduction, a CD-deck Cue / Jog scrub, a turntable-style Speed control and a Punch In / Punch Out looper. The touch screen is styled after an Akai S950 front panel. ## Disclaimer > **Z950 is experimental software, provided "AS IS", without warranty
